To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the LI and MI of primary cultured cells from oral tumors are generally much higher than those of the corresponding surgical specimens, and (2) the degree of increase in the LI and MI in cultured cells is closely related to the malignancy of the tumors, but the degree of increase is much lower in flat epithelial cell carcinoma than in the other tumor groups.

(1) The LI and MI of the primary culture cells from the oral cancer patients were significantly higher than those of the normal buccal mucosa cells; (2) The degree of LI and MI in the primary culture cells of the oral cancer patients was significantly different according to the histological type of tumor, being higher in the squamous cell carcinoma and verrucous carcinoma than in the ameloblastoma and adenomatoid odontogenic tumor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
cell kinetic studies of human oral tumor tissues, using 3H-thymidind autoradiography.
the cell kinetics of human oral tumors and their primary culture.
the biological nature and cell kinetics of human oral neoplasms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cell proliferation kinetics of oral tumor tissues and primary culture cells were highly variable among the cases.

the proliferative activity of oral tumor tissues, in general, is higher than the corresponding normal tissue and, furthermore, that the proliferative capacity of the tumor cells in vitro is even higher.

the cell kinetics in oral tumors are quite different from those in normal oral mucosa, and the differences are more marked in squamous cell carcinoma than in other tumors, and that the differences are also dependent on histopathological features of each tumor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the cell kinetics of oral tumor tissues and primary culture cells from them were studied by 3H-thymidin autoradiography.
the proliferative potential in the oral tumor tissues and the primary cultured cells from the oral tumor tissues was higher than that in normal oral mucosa.
the proliferative activity of the human oral tumor tissue and their primary culture cell were examined by autoradiographic method using 3H-thymidin.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the context of the present study, the most important thing is to understand the relationship between the two types of cells.
the use of the 3D model is an effective way to study the effect of drugs on the proliferation of tumor cells.
the use of the cell proliferation index (CPI), as a surrogate marker for tumor aggressiveness, should be avoided in the setting of HNSCC.
